name.en-US: Treatise on the Knowledge of God
name.pt-BR: Tratado sobre o conhecimento de Deus

description.la: Tractatus de cognitione Dei in tredecim capitibus, in tomo VIII operum a Vivès editus (auctoris adscriptio non confirmata).
description.en-US: A short treatise on the knowledge of God in thirteen chapters, printed in the Vivès volume of Bellarmine's ascetical works (the attribution to Bellarmine is not verified). Latin only.
description.pt-BR: Breve tratado sobre o conhecimento de Deus, impresso no volume ascético da edição Vivès (autoria não confirmada).

sources.edition: Roberti Bellarmini Opera omnia, ed. Justin Fèvre, tom. 8 (Paris: Vivès, 1870-74).
sources.description: Archive.org OCR (djvu.txt, Boston College copy) cleaned by script: running heads, page numbers and the reference-only footnote blocks removed, line-end hyphens joined, recognisable OCR slips corrected by a lexicon pass, so some remain.
sources.tierEvidence: Bellarmine died in 1621; the Vivès edition of 1870-74 is public domain.
